name: Seaduced Luxury Charters
summary: Seaduced runs private charters from its dock at the Shallow Draught in Bridgetown, on three catamarans and three powerboats. Each day is planned around your group: turtle swims, reef and wreck snorkelling, a quiet bay and a meal cooked on board by the chef. Children of any age are welcome.
standouts: Fleet of six boats, from a 62ft Lagoon 620 catamaran to a 37ft powerboat
Chef prepares food fresh on board
Children allowed on all charters, no minimum age
Beach boarding possible from certain West Coast beaches

trips.title: Seaduced III
trips.summary: A private charter on a 62ft Lagoon 620 catamaran with a flybridge and wide decks, for up to 20 guests. You choose the plan with the captain, from turtle swims and snorkelling to a slow sail along the coast.
highlights: Cuisine by the chef and premium open bar at a per-person supplement
trips.departsFrom: Shallow Draught, St Michael (beach collection from certain West Coast beaches)

Festive rate surcharge for charters booked 20 December to 6 January. 5 hour minimum for beach collection and drop off. 3 hour charters considered if starting at 4pm or later. Surcharge may apply for Port St Charles or Port Ferdinand boarding. Booking is by enquiry form, WhatsApp, phone or email.

trips.title: Charlotte
trips.summary: A private charter on an Italian-built Pardo 50 powerboat for up to 12 guests, with a captain and crew. Cruise the coast, snorkel with turtles and stop at a beach bar or restaurant.
highlights: Swim platform lowers into the water
Restaurant and beach club stops can be added
